about: An explosion: a charge of fuel blown out fast from the ground, a flash of flame that burns out within a second into a rolling soot ball rising on its own column. The fireball class's violent one-shot.
channels: R heat, G cover, B soot, A distortion

motion.channels: RG flow to the next frame in frame widths: (v - 0.5) * 2 * scale, y down
